title: Fresh VPN signed update manifest
description: FROZEN v1 (2026-06-30). Signed payload for service-mediated silent self-update. Ed25519 signature (manifest.sig) is computed over the RAW UTF-8 bytes of the canonical/minified manifest.json BEFORE any JSON parse (auditor H2). Any new field without bumping schema_version => service MUST reject (CISO #6).

signature_keyid.description: lowercase hex of first 8 bytes of SHA-256(pinned SPKI DER). Selects which pinned pubkey (current/next) the service verifies against (auditor C2).

path.description: relative POSIX path under installDir. No '..', no leading '/', no drive, no UNC, no backslash. Whitelist ext only: exe dll qml qmlc qm ts json ico (CISO #3). MUST NOT include FreshVPN-service.exe in v1 (CISO #10 / auditor H4) - service SKIPs it.
